描述_EN: as this vessel was meant for every day use, perfection was not necessarily sought by its maker. the exact origin of this white stoneware flask is unknown, but its shape and glaze are typical of the kilns in northern china during the liao (907-1125) and northern song (960-1127) dynasties.the body of this pot was first formed and then covered with a white slip (a layer of diluted firing clay) in order to whiten and even out the surface. this was then covered in a white glaze and fired. these marks would have been made as the flask was handled after applying the glaze, and were not smoothed over before it was fired. the maker has left clearly visible fingerprints on the surface.
描述_ZN: 由于这个器皿是为日常使用而准备的，其制造者不一定要追求完美。 这个白瓷瓶的确切来源不详，但它的形状和釉面是辽代（907-1125）和北宋（960-1127）时期中国北方窑场的典型特征。这个罐子的主体首先成型，然后用白滑（一层稀释的烧制粘土）覆盖，以使表面变白和均匀。 这是在白色的釉面上覆盖并烧制。 这些痕迹应该是在施釉后处理烧瓶时留下的，并且在烧制前没有被抹平。 制作者在表面上留下了清晰可见的手指印。
